info.title: Basecraft API
info.description: Versioned REST API. NOT a drop-in Airtable API: identifiers are stable field IDs, updates are partial merges with optimistic versions, and pagination is cursor-based. See docs/MIGRATION.md.

bearer.description: API token ("bc_…"). Scoped to a workspace and optional bases/tables; can never administer members, tokens, automations or schema.

session.name: bc_session
session.description: Browser session. State-changing requests also need the X-CSRF-Token header.

get.summary: Download a file (always as an attachment, never rendered inline)

delete.summary: Remove a file (blob is deleted by the orphan cleaner after a grace period)

post.summary: Change password and revoke all other sessions
Sign in with email and password
Sign out and revoke the current session

get.summary: Current user, workspaces, and CSRF token

post.summary: Create an account (and a first workspace)

get.summary: Run history (inputs are redacted to ids; no record values are stored)

post.summary: Test against a real record. mode "preview" (default) validates and returns the effects WITHOUT writing; "execute" really performs the (internal) record actions. No outgoing HTTP/email action types exist yet.

delete.summary: Delete an automation and its run history

patch.summary: Replace an automation definition (or toggle enabled)

post.summary: Create a table (a primary "Name" text field is added if none is given)

delete.summary: Delete a base (soft delete; data is retained and recoverable by an operator)
Delete a field (soft: stored values are retained so the field can be restored by an operator)

patch.summary: Rename / reorder a field, edit select options, or toggle its expression index. Field TYPE cannot change in Phase 1 (see FEATURE_PARITY.md).

post.summary: Cancel a queued/running import (already-committed batches stay)
Resume a failed import from its last committed batch (the uploaded file is kept for failed jobs)

get.summary: Import job status, counters, and the validation report

post.summary: Accept an invitation with its token
Upload one file (multipart/form-data, part name "file") into an attachment field of a record. Query: field_id.
Add a comment (plain text)

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: Record version as an ETag, e.g. "3". Mismatch returns 412 with the current record. Required unless the version is supplied in the body/query.

patch.summary: Update fields of a record (only the supplied fields change; null clears). Requires If-Match: "<version>" or body.version → 412 on conflict.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: Record version as an ETag, e.g. "3". Mismatch returns 412 with the current record. Required unless the version is supplied in the body/query.

post.summary: Create an automation: trigger (record created/updated, condition matched, form submitted) → conditions → actions (update_record, create_record)
Export ALL records matching the optional query/view (CSV or JSON), streamed in bounded batches. Formula-injection-safe CSV.
Add a field
Preview a CSV: headers, sample rows, row count, suggested column mapping, and validation of the first 500 rows (nothing is stored)

get.summary: Recent import jobs for a table

post.summary: Start a CSV import job. Multipart parts: file, mapping (JSON [{column, field}]), options (JSON). Validates the whole file first; rows commit in atomic batches of 500; resumable.
Apply up to 100 create/update/delete operations atomically (all succeed or none do). Updates and deletes carry their expected version.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Makes retries of this create safe for 24 hours; reusing a key with a different body returns 422.

post.summary: Query records with filter groups (AND/OR), sorts, search, projection, and stable cursor pagination

get.summary: List records (cursor pagination, field projection). Use POST /records/query for filter groups and sorts.

post.summary: Create one record ({fields}) or up to 100 atomically ({records:[...]}). Supports Idempotency-Key.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Makes retries of this create safe for 24 hours; reusing a key with a different body returns 422.

get.summary: List views you can see (shared, locked, and your personal views)

post.summary: Save a view (grid, kanban, gallery, calendar, form)
Rotate: issue a replacement with the same scopes and revoke the old token
Submit a form view. Only fields listed in the form configuration are accepted; required fields are enforced.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Makes retries of this create safe for 24 hours; reusing a key with a different body returns 422.

patch.summary: Update a view (name, config, visibility). Optional body.version guards against overwriting a teammate's change.

get.summary: Read the append-only audit trail (newest first)

post.summary: Create a base

put.summary: Set (or clear with role=null) a role override for one user on a base or table. role "none" hides the resource.

post.summary: Create an invitation (returns the one-time token; no email is sent)

get.summary: List API tokens (never returns token values)

post.summary: Create an API token (value shown once). Tokens can never administer members, tokens, automations, or schema.
Create a workspace (you become owner)
